mechanism: A source read becomes a real reload only when no load of the same address dominates it, or a may-alias store sits in between. The hand-written AccountInfo clones' Rc strong-count stores carry no noalias metadata, so field reads written as a.<field>.<f> after a clone reload the account pointer from the accounts struct, whereas an x binding keeps it in one SSA value.
